page.overview:
Who is Aideen?

Aideen was an elf and the younger sister of Fionnuala.

While travelling through the woods with Fionnuala one day, they came across the witcher Geralt of Rivia tied up and blindfolded during his Trial of Forest Eyes. While Fionnuala told her not to help the witcher, Aideen chose to leave her to untie him. Appreciative, the witcher went to walk off towards his camp, though Aideen summoned a deer for them to ride on.

Passing by a vran and werebbubb reserve, they marched forward and saw King Radowit II, the sorceresses April and Dorreniel, and the witchers Rennes and Treyse searching for Geralt. Aideen and Geralt moved on and hid before kissing and eating together.

Upon later travel, the two came across the School of the Cat camp, and Aideen described what was happening to a still blindfolded Geralt. He left her in the woods, as he had come across his camp.
